analytical_model_policy: NO_ANALYTICAL_WORK_MODEL unless exact source/data diagnostics justify a workload-specific count

exclusions.Q11: Recursive counterpart to selected iterative Q10; excluded to avoid duplicating the same k-means semantics.
exclusions.Q12: Random noise plus current-time predicate prevents exact deterministic cross-system validation.
exclusions.Q13: External JSON/table pipeline overlaps selected Q7 and has less relational optimization context than Q14.
exclusions.Q15: Complex XML/anti-join case has high setup cost; Q14 supplies the bounded QC3 optimizer case.
exclusions.Q16: Very large multi-UDF pipeline is redundant with Q9/Q14/Q17 for this bounded study.
exclusions.Q18: Cartesian text-similarity pipeline risks timeout and duplicates selected Q17's text-processing phenomenon.
exclusions.Q19: Pivot/subquery table-UDF behavior overlaps Q10's internal-subquery boundary.
exclusions.Q2: Near-duplicate of Q1 date extraction; table-returning form adds less representation diversity than selected cases.
exclusions.Q20: DML update would require state restoration for every trial and is outside the selected read-only primary set.
exclusions.Q21: DML insert and external-file case is outside the read-only primary set.
exclusions.Q3: Multilingual deployment requires a C extension build and DuckDB/SQLite do not support the released case.
exclusions.Q4: Aggregate-only behavior is covered more richly by selected Q7/Q8.
exclusions.Q5: Blocking whole-table statistics overlaps Q7/Q10 without adding a distinct selected phenomenon.
exclusions.Q6: Writes an output file; side-effect validation would dominate the representation question.

failure_criteria: Semantic mismatch excludes a workload/system from comparable timing.
Timeout, dependency failure, unsupported UDF type, or runner incompatibility is retained as negative evidence.
Non-deterministic Q10 labels may be validated by invariant rather than byte-identical labels; otherwise it is excluded from cross-system comparison.
hypotheses: Q1 will expose row-wise invocation amplification while loop/branch structure remains optimizer-opaque.
Q7 will expose external data access and JSON-dependent work unavailable to ordinary optimizer costing.
Q8 will expose join-conditioned invocation volume and input-length-dependent JSON work absent from scalar metadata.
Q9 will expose combinatorial amplification guarded by a relational predicate, qualitatively connecting E1 and E2.
Q10 will expose bounded but data-dependent iterative work and an internal relational subquery behind a table-UDF boundary.
Q14 will expose natural relational filtering/join context around opaque parsing and date-cleaning functions, qualitatively connecting E2.
Q17 will expose a deep, input-conditioned multi-UDF text pipeline and may reveal a timeout or memory boundary.
planned_plots: per-system median runtime with bootstrap interval if at least three successful selected workloads justify a figure

stop_conditions: Stop an individual trial after 60 seconds.
Do not add workloads after outcomes are seen.
Do not install a new DBMS or modify frozen E1-E5b/Task 1 artifacts.
Stop Task 2 after required analysis, freeze verification, and exactly one next-task recommendation.
success_criteria: At least several semantically faithful workloads execute.
At least two procedural representation phenomena are present.
Natural plans and visibility evidence are preserved separately from timings.
Cross-system output equivalence is established where intended or the case is excluded from comparison.

systems.DuckDB: project-local Task 2 environment pinned to repository requirement DuckDB 1.0.0; released DuckDB ports
systems.PostgreSQL: new Task 2 cluster created with existing validated PostgreSQL 14.24 binaries; released PL/Python implementations
systems.SQLite: validated system SQLite; new Task 2 database copy; released sqlite query/UDF implementations when present

thread_policy: one configured engine thread where controllable; no cross-system performance ranking
